source_documents.title: Spontaneously Self-Assembled Naphthalimide Nanosheets: Aggregation Induced Emission and Unveiling a-PET for Sensitive Detection of Organic Volatile Contaminants in Water
Spontaneously Self-Assembled Naphthalimide Nanosheets: Aggregation Induced Emission and Unveiling a-PET for Sensitive Detection of Organic Volatile Contaminants in Water

reference_evidence_units.quote: ODNI started aggregating at 40% fw with redshifted intense AIE emission
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DMF/water, excitation 350 nm; main-text discussion of SI Figs. S3-S4.
reference_evidence_units.statement: ODNI aggregation begins near 40% water with more than 5- to 8-fold enhanced emission; HNI remains molecularly dispersed up to 90%.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI not inspected; thresholds differ between congeners.

reference_evidence_units.quote: with two emission bands at 380 nm and 530-540 nm which could be assigned to π- π transition and excimer emission respectively
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI and HNI
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Very weak emission in nominally molecularly dissolved pure DMF, 350 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors tentatively assign the long-wavelength DMF band to excimer emission.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Preserve weak assignment but note tension with the stated molecularly dissolved condition; not proof that 465 nm nanosheet emission is excimer emission.

reference_evidence_units.quote: AFM images displayed that the ODNI-NS had a height of ~8-10 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheets
reference_evidence_units.conditions: DMF solution added to water with vigorous stirring; dialysis removes residual DMF; FESEM/AFM Fig. 2.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Source reports sheet-like nanoaggregates with 8-10 nm height.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Thickness measurement does not by itself prove an exact bilayer; source molecular-length/bilayer geometry remains model-dependent.

reference_evidence_units.quote: All these interactions were almost abolished in ODNI-NS indicating the existence of NI cores in an amorphous phase in the NS.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheet packing
reference_evidence_units.conditions: PXRD compared with naphthalic anhydride and octadecylamine; Fig. 3.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Loss of NA-like pi-stacking reflections is interpreted as amorphous NI cores; retained alkyl-chain reflections support chain-directed assembly.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: No ODNI single crystal: HNI SCXRD must not be represented as ODNI crystallography.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The ODNI-NS suspension in water having strong and stable blue emission centered at 465 nm
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheets with OVCs
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Water, p-xylene or mesitylene titration; Fig. 6, 20 micromolar ODNI, 350 nm excitation.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Aqueous nanosheet emission peaks at 465 nm and is quenched approximately 75% by 20 ppm p-xylene or mesitylene.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Not complete quenching; authors suggest some NI cores remain inaccessible.

reference_evidence_units.quote: favoring strong intermolecular π-π interactions between electron deficit NI core and electron rich phenyl derivatives.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheet analyte interaction
reference_evidence_units.conditions: OVC association with nanosheet surfaces in water.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose hydrophobic and pi interactions bringing electron-rich analytes to exposed NI cores.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Surface-association model, not measured cavity inclusion or an exact stoichiometric host complex.

reference_evidence_units.quote: from 3.511 ns to 1.946 ns on addition of 100 ppm p-xylene
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI nanosheets
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Time-resolved emission in water; Fig. 6d visually inspected.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Lifetime shortens with p-xylene, consistent with an additional excited-state quenching route.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Lifetime alone does not uniquely prove electron transfer or exclude mixed static/dynamic quenching.

reference_evidence_units.quote: the process of a-PET from electron rich OVCs to ODNI-NS could be involved in the suppression of fluorescence emission.
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI OVC sensing
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Electron-deficient NI acceptor excited at 350 nm; OVC titration.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Authors propose acceptor-excited PET from OVC to NI for xylene/mesitylene quenching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Distinct from donor-excited PET proposed for nitrobenzenes; not an intramolecular CT assignment.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The obtained HOMO value for ODNI was −6.565 eV
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI/OVC energetics
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Reported DFT frontier levels; Fig. 6f visually inspected and Table S3 referenced.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Calculated HOMO ordering is used to argue for a-PET from p-xylene and mesitylene.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: Orbital energies alone are not measured transfer free energies or kinetics; SI computational details not inspected.

reference_evidence_units.quote: A steady enhancement in the hydrodynamic diameter of the NS with increasing analytes concentration
reference_evidence_units.subject: ODNI disaggregation control
reference_evidence_units.conditions: Main-text account of DLS versus analyte concentration, SI Figs. S22-S23.
reference_evidence_units.statement: Reported increasing size argues against disaggregation as the cause of quenching.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: SI DLS not inspected; the stronger claim that sensing is completely a surface phenomenon remains interpretation, not established solely by DLS.

reference_mechanisms.label: PACKING_HOST_MATRIX_CONFINEMENT
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Chain-directed assembly suppresses detrimental core stacking according to source; not automatically internal RIM.

reference_mechanisms.label: HOST_GUEST_INTERACTION
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Broad host/analyte interaction family applied provisionally to nanosheet-surface association, not pore or cavity inclusion.

reference_mechanisms.label: PET_ET
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Central sensing explanation is a-PET from electron-rich analyte to excited NI; retained as supported but not uniquely proven.

reference_mechanisms.label: AGGREGATE_EXCITON_EXCIMER
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Retain the explicitly tentative excimer assignment for the weak DMF band only; do not recast the nanosheet AIE peak as established excimer emission.

mechanism_decisions.label: RIM_RIR_RIV
mechanism_decisions.rationale: No target-specific restriction of intramolecular motion is established in the selected evidence; aggregation alone is insufficient.
